# NourPharmcies<!doctype html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>روابط صيدليات نور</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Tajawal:wght@500;800&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: one narrow column, phone-first, like a pharmacy loyalty card */
:root{
  --bg:#f6f8f6; --card:#ffffff; --fg:#1c2420; --muted:#5e6b64;
  --red:#d7262e; --green:#1f9a55; --line:#e3e9e5;
  --display:"Tajawal","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",Tahoma,sans-serif;
  --body:"IBM Plex Sans Arabic",Tahoma,sans-serif;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#121815; --card:#1b231f; --fg:#eef3f0; --muted:#a3b2aa; --red:#ff5a5f; --green:#3fc77c; --line:#2b3530; color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#121815; --card:#1b231f; --fg:#eef3f0; --muted:#a3b2aa; --red:#ff5a5f; --green:#3fc77c; --line:#2b3530; color-scheme:dark}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--body);direction:rtl;
  padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));padding-block:32px}
.wrap{max-width:440px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px}
header{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-align:center}
.logo{width:160px;height:160px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:34px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#ffffff 72%,#e6ece8);
  border:4px solid #0aa800;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;color:#cc0000;
  box-shadow:inset 0 3px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.9),inset 0 -6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.12),0 6px 0 #0a7d00,0 14px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 #b00000,0 2px 0 #9a0000,0 3px 0 #840000,0 5px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
h1{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:34px;margin:0;color:#cc0000;text-wrap:balance;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 #b00000,0 2px 0 #a00000,0 3px 0 #900000,0 4px 0 #800000,0 7px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.logo img{width:90%;height:90%;object-fit:contain}
.pill{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ff3b3b,#cc0000 55%,#a30000);color:#fff;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;
  padding:8px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-size:16px;text-shadow:0 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  box-shadow:inset 0 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45),inset 0 -4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 5px 0 #7a0000,0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.pill::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:3px 12px 50% 12px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.5),rgba(255,255,255,0));pointer-events:none}
.links{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
a.btn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg);transition:transform .15s}
a.btn:hover .ic{transform:translateY(-2px)}
a.btn:focus-visible{outline:none}
a.btn:focus-visible .ic{outline:3px solid var(--green);outline-offset:4px}
.ic{position:relative;width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:inset 0 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45),inset 0 -5px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28),0 6px 0 var(--depth),0 12px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  transition:transform .12s,box-shadow .12s}
.ic::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4px 6px 50% 6px;border-radius:18px 18px 40% 40%;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.55),rgba(255,255,255,0));pointer-events:none}
.ic svg{position:relative;width:34px;height:34px;fill:currentColor;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
a.btn:active .ic{transform:translateY(5px);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45),inset 0 -3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.28),0 1px 0 var(--depth),0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.lbl{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:500;font-size:14px}
@media (max-width:340px){.ic{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:16px}.ic svg{width:28px;height:28px}}
.fb{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4a9bff,#1877f2 55%,#0d5bc6);--depth:#0a479c}.ig{background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 110%,#fdf497 0%,#fd5949 40%,#d6249f 65%,#285aeb 100%);--depth:#7a1a72}.tt{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a3a3a,#111 60%);--depth:#000;text-shadow:none}.web{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4fd08a,#1f9a55 55%,#147a42);--depth:#0e5a30}
.hot{background:var(--card);border:2px dashed var(--red);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hot b{font-family:var(--display);font-size:32px;color:var(--red);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:1px}
.hot button{font-family:var(--display);background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}
.hot button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:2px}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){a.btn,.ic{transition:none}}

html{min-height:100%;background:#5a0010}
body{min-height:100vh;box-sizing:border-box;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(90,0,16,0) 0,rgba(90,0,16,0) calc(44vw - 30px),#5a0010 calc(44vw + 4px)),url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center top/100% auto no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%,#8a0a1e,#4a000c 70%) #5a0010 !important}
.lbl{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
footer{color:#fff !important;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.hot{background:#fff !important;color:#1c2420;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.wrap{padding-top:calc(44vw + 4px)}
@media (min-width:900px){.wrap{padding-top:calc(44vw - 220px)}}
.logo{width:140px !important;height:140px !important}

/* branches */
.branches{background:#fff;color:#1c2420;border-radius:22px;padding:22px 14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.branches h2{align-self:center;margin:-40px 0 0;position:relative;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4fd08a,#1f9a55 55%,#147a42);padding:8px 26px;border-radius:999px;text-shadow:0 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  box-shadow:inset 0 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45),inset 0 -4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 5px 0 #0e5a30,0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.count{text-align:center;color:#5e6b64;font-size:13px;margin-top:-4px}
.tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.tab{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:14px;border:0;cursor:pointer;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;
  background:#f1f4f2;color:#1c2420;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 #d5ddd8;transition:transform .1s}
.tab span{font-weight:500;color:#5e6b64;font-size:12px}
.tab[aria-pressed="true"]{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ff3b3b,#cc0000 60%,#a30000);color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4),0 4px 0 #7a0000}
.tab[aria-pressed="true"] span{color:#ffd9d9}
.tab:active{transform:translateY(3px)}
.tab:focus-visible,#q:focus-visible,.map:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1f9a55;outline-offset:2px}
#q{font:inherit;font-size:15px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:2px solid #e3e9e5;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:#f8faf9;color:#1c2420}
.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.br{border:1px solid #e3e9e5;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:6px 10px;align-items:center}
.br h3{margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:17px;color:#cc0000;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.new{font-size:11px;background:#0aa800;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px}
.addr{grid-column:1/-1;color:#3d4842;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;min-width:0}
.meta{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:8px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:13px}
.hrs{background:#f1f4f2;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;color:#3d4842}
.hrs.h24{background:#e3f6ea;color:#147a42;font-weight:600}
.meta a.ph{color:#1c2420;text-decoration:none;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;direction:ltr;unicode-bidi:isolate}
.map{grid-row:1;grid-column:2;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 12px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4fd08a,#1f9a55 55%,#147a42);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4),0 4px 0 #0e5a30;white-space:nowrap}
.map:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #0e5a30}
.empty{text-align:center;color:#5e6b64;padding:12px}
.wrap{gap:30px !important}
</style>
</head>

var list=document.getElementById('list'), q=document.getElementById('q');
var tabs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.tab'));
function esc(s){return s.replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]})}
function norm(s){return s.replace(/[أإآ]/g,'ا').replace(/ة/g,'ه').replace(/ى/g,'ي').replace(/[٠-٩]/g,function(d){return '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d)})}
tabs.forEach(function(t){var n=B.filter(function(b){return b.c===t.dataset.c}).length;t.querySelector('span').textContent='('+n+')';
  t.addEventListener('click',function(){cur=t.dataset.c;tabs.forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',x===t)});render()})});
document.getElementById('cnt').textContent=B.filter(function(b){return b.c!=='S'}).length+' صيدلية و'+B.filter(function(b){return b.c==='S'}).length+' فروع نور ستور';
q.addEventListener('input',render);
function render(){
  var term=norm(q.value.trim()), out='';
  var rows=B.filter(function(b){return term? norm(b.n+' '+b.a).indexOf(term)>-1 : b.c===cur});
  rows.forEach(function(b){
    var ph=[b.m,b.l].filter(Boolean).map(function(p){var d=p.replace(/[^0-9]/g,'');return '<a class="ph" href="tel:'+d+'">'+esc(p)+'</a>'}).join(' · ');
    out+='<article class="br"><h3>'+esc(b.n)+(b.new?'<span class="new">فرع جديد</span>':'')+'</h3>'+
      '<a class="map" href="'+b.u+'">الموقع ↖</a>'+
      (b.c!=='S'||b.a!==b.n?'<div class="addr">'+esc(b.a)+'</div>':'')+
      '<div class="meta">'+(b.h?'<span class="hrs'+(b.h==='24 ساعة'?' h24':'')+'">'+esc(b.h)+'</span>':'')+ph+'</div></article>';
  });
  list.innerHTML=out||'<div class="empty">لا يوجد فرع بهذا الاسم. جرّب كلمة أخرى.</div>';
}
render();
})();
</script>
